title: Om gutten som gikk til nordavinden og krevde melet tilbake
placement: Each illustration belongs directly after the paragraph with index "paragraph" (0-based, paragraphs split on blank lines).

cover.caption: Gutten går helt opp på fjellet for å si ifra til Nordavinden.
cover.alt: Gutten står på en snødekt fjellrygg med hendene i siden og ser opp på Nordavinden. Nordavinden fyller hele himmelen, blåser ut kinnene og sender snø mot ham.
cover.prompt: On a windswept, snowy mountain ridge under a cold blue-grey sky, the Boy stands with his feet planted wide and his fists on his hips, looking up at the enormous face of the North Wind, which fills the sky above him, cheeks puffed out and eyebrows bristling, blowing a gust of snowflakes at him. The Boy's scarf and hair stream out behind him, but he doesn't budge an inch.

Create the cover illustration for a children's picture book, in a square format. Do not write a title or any other text on it.

Picture: On a windswept, snowy mountain ridge under a cold blue-grey sky, the Boy stands with his feet planted wide and his fists on his hips, looking up at the enormous face of the North Wind, which fills the sky above him, cheeks puffed out and eyebrows bristling, blowing a gust of snowflakes at him. The Boy's scarf and hair stream out behind him, but he doesn't budge an inch.

Characters in this picture (nobody else, unless the picture description mentions them):
- the Boy: A small, skinny boy of about nine with a narrow, pale face, cheeks rosy from the cold, big sticking-out ears, bright blue eyes, a determined little frown and white-blond hair that sticks up in tufts. He wears a baggy grey knitted jumper that is too big for him, patched dark-brown trousers, thick grey wool stockings, worn leather boots and a long brown knitted scarf.
- the North Wind: A huge, grumbling old man made of swirling white and pale-grey clouds, with no legs, only a long, whirling tail of mist and snowflakes. He has a broad face with puffed-out round cheeks, icy-blue eyes, big bushy white eyebrows, a thick moustache made of snow and a long, frosty white beard that streams away in the wind, and big, soft cloud hands. Snowflakes and tiny icicles glitter in his hair.

Story world: Old rural Norway, long ago, in the first cold weeks of winter. The boy and his mother live in a small, grey, weathered log cottage with a turf roof; beside it stands a little stabbur, a storehouse on posts with a steep wooden stair up to its door. Far away, on top of a high, snowy mountain with a few wind-bent spruces, lives the North Wind. By the road home lies the inn, a big, low log house with a lantern at the door and a goat shed behind. The magic cloth is a square white linen tablecloth with a red woven zigzag border, and the swapped one looks exactly the same. The stick is a knobbly old stick of pale birch wood, about as long as the boy is tall. The flour is carried in a small grey sack.

This story's season, light and colours: The first cold weeks of winter: a thin, new layer of snow on frozen ground, hoarfrost on every twig, blustery wind and cold blue-grey skies with fast grey clouds; deep snow on the North Wind's mountain. Indoors: warm, golden firelight and candlelight against the cold blue light at the windows.

Art style: Warm Scandinavian children's picture-book illustration: gouache and watercolour on lightly textured cold-press paper, with soft coloured-pencil outlines and visible brush and paper texture. Rounded, friendly shapes and simple, expressive faces with clear emotions, but every character has their own face shape, nose, eyes, hair, build and age exactly as described, so no two characters look alike. Base palette of moss green, spruce green, lingonberry red, birch white, fjord teal, honey yellow and warm earth browns, shifted towards each story's own season, light and colours. The picture fills the whole image, with no border, frame or lettering. Costumes and places from old rural Norway: spruce and birch forests, fjords and mountains, turf-roofed log houses, carved wood, rosemaling patterns, wool and linen clothes. Kings and princesses wear simple storybook finery. Trolls are huge, lumpy and mossy and look silly rather than scary. Clear, uncluttered composition with one focal point and room to breathe. Cosy, safe and full of wonder. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not anime, no glossy digital look.

characters.name: Gutten
characters.description: En hjelpsom og modig gutt som vil gjøre det rette for å skaffe mat til moren sin.
characters.look: A small, skinny boy of about nine with a narrow, pale face, cheeks rosy from the cold, big sticking-out ears, bright blue eyes, a determined little frown and white-blond hair that sticks up in tufts. He wears a baggy grey knitted jumper that is too big for him, patched dark-brown trousers, thick grey wool stockings, worn leather boots and a long brown knitted scarf.

characters.name: Moren
characters.description: En gammel, sliten mor som gutten passer på, og som blir lettet når de endelig får hjelp.
characters.look: A thin, tired old woman of about sixty-five, a little stooped, with a long, gentle, deeply lined face, tired grey eyes, a thin mouth and one eyebrow often raised in doubt. Her grey hair hangs in one thin braid over her shoulder. She wears a faded plum-coloured wool dress, a darned brown knitted cardigan, a long patched linen apron and wooden clogs.

characters.name: Nordavinden
characters.description: En kraftig, men rettferdig vind som kan virke brummete, men som gir gutten magiske gaver når han ber om hjelp.
characters.look: A huge, grumbling old man made of swirling white and pale-grey clouds, with no legs, only a long, whirling tail of mist and snowflakes. He has a broad face with puffed-out round cheeks, icy-blue eyes, big bushy white eyebrows, a thick moustache made of snow and a long, frosty white beard that streams away in the wind, and big, soft cloud hands. Snowflakes and tiny icicles glitter in his hair.

characters.name: Gjestgiveren
characters.description: En lur vert som prøver å bytte til seg de magiske tingene, men lærer å gjøre opp for seg.
characters.look: A tall, gangly innkeeper of about fifty with a long, narrow face, a much too wide, toothy smile, small glittering eyes, a long pointed chin and oily black hair twisted into one big curl on his forehead. He wears a wine-red waistcoat with shiny brass buttons over a white shirt with rolled sleeves, a long blue-and-white striped apron, dark breeches and a wide black leather money belt that jingles with coins.

characters.name: Den magiske bukken
characters.description: En liten bukk som kan lage gull når gutten sier de rette ordene.
characters.look: A small, sturdy billy goat about as big as a large dog, with a shaggy snow-white coat, a light-grey face with a little pointed grey beard, bright amber eyes with slot-shaped pupils, short, curved, ridged horns, a stubby tail, neat black hooves and a red leather collar hung with two small brass bells.

places.name: the Cottage Kitchen
places.look: A small, low log room with dark, smoke-stained walls and a ceiling of rough beams. A stone fireplace with a black cooking pot glows in the corner, a plain wooden table stands under a small frosted window, a bench runs along the wall, and a broom and a water bucket stand by the door. A worn rag rug lies on the floorboards. Poor, but tidy and cosy.

places.name: the Inn Parlour
places.look: A big, low-ceilinged parlour in an old log inn, with dark timber walls, a large open fireplace with a crackling fire, two long plank tables with benches, a small corner table under a window, an iron lantern hanging from a beam, pewter mugs on a shelf and a heavy plank door to the frosty yard. Warm, smoky and golden.

illustrations.anchor: SSSSSSUUUUUUSJ! Nordavinden tok nesten gutten også.
illustrations.caption: SSSSSSUUUUUUSJ! Nordavinden tar nesten gutten også.
illustrations.alt: Gutten står på stabburstrappa og klamrer seg til melsekken, mens Nordavinden blåser så beina hans nesten letter. Melet fyker av gårde som et hvitt slør over gårdsplassen.

illustrations.anchor: «Jeg har ikke noe mel», sa Nordavinden.
illustrations.caption: «Jeg har ikke noe mel», sier Nordavinden. «Men du skal få en duk.»
